sources.snippet: Marco-LLM-AR-V2 is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find Marco-LLM-AR-V2 on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of Marco-LLM-AR-V2 install, users can directly use Marco-LLM-AR-V2 installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial. It also supports api for free installation.
